extracted.intended_audience: published creative writers interested in NEA Literature Fellowships (prose or poetry)
extracted.subtask_description: Information and program-level requirements for applying to the National Endowment for the Arts Literature Fellowships (creative writing) offering $25,000 grants in prose and poetry. Describes eligible genres, purpose of the award, cycle/timing, and basic eligibility (published writers).

rubrics_metrics.name: Grant amount
rubrics_metrics.description: The National Endowment for the Arts Literature Fellowships program offers $25,000 grants.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Grants are awarded to individual creative writers; the page states the award amount ($25,000) but does not provide additional scoring guidance or breakdown of payment terms on this excerpt.

rubrics_metrics.name: Eligible genres
rubrics_metrics.description: Fellowships are offered in prose (fiction and creative nonfiction) and poetry.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The program operates on a two-year cycle with fellowships in prose and poetry available in alternating years; the page notes that in 2024 applications will be accepted in poetry.

rubrics_metrics.name: Target applicant profile / basic eligibility
rubrics_metrics.description: Awards are for published creative writers.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The page's wording ('to published creative writers') indicates publication is a baseline eligibility requirement; detailed eligibility rules (e.g., publication types, residency, citizenship) are not included in this excerpt and likely appear on the full 'Eligibility' page.

rubrics_metrics.name: Purpose / acceptable use of the fellowship
rubrics_metrics.description: Grants enable recipients to set aside time for writing, research, travel, and general career advancement.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The fellowship is intended to support activities that advance a writer's career and creative work (time for writing, research, travel). The excerpt does not specify restrictions or reporting requirements for fund use.

rubrics_metrics.name: Program timing / cycle
rubrics_metrics.description: The program operates on a two-year cycle with fellowships in prose and poetry available in alternating years.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicants should note which genre is open in a given year (e.g., 2024 is poetry). Additional calendar details (deadlines, review timeline) are available on linked pages such as 'Application Calendar' and 'Application Review'.

rubrics_metrics.name: Further information and contact
rubrics_metrics.description: If you have questions about your application, contact Literary Arts staff at 202-682-5034 or email LitFellowships@arts.gov.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The page points applicants to program-specific pages (Program Description, Eligibility, How to Apply, Application Review, etc.) and to contact information for direct inquiries; use those resources for detailed rubrics, eligibility criteria, and application instructions.
